thread:
jade-support: Customer ACME-prod reports 504s on hosted inference streaming endpoint since 10:12 UTC. High concurrent sessions (~200 r/s), long streams (~30s). Customer says request body small but responses cut.

jade-support: curl sample they used:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -H "X-Tenant-Meta: very-long-tenant-meta-blob-..." \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-open-2","input":"tokenize this"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream
```

sam-eng-sre: Any trace IDs? gateway logs? 504 suggests upstream timeout or proxy queue overflow.

jade-support: Paste from customer: trace=trc_0a1b2c3d; gateway log snippet: `nginx: upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out) while reading response header from upstream` Also see `upstream prematurely closed connection` interleaved.

liam-runtime: That pattern + long streams -> keepalive pool exhaustion or h2 stream windowing. Need full gateway->upstream conn counts. Can you grab edge-proxy metrics for that minute (conn_active, idle, h2_streams)?

jade-support: Adding graphs now, upload referencing convo. Initial quick mitigation requested by customer.

nora-product: Customer asks if setting smaller max_concurrency or switching to non-streaming fallback is reasonable short-term.

sam-eng-sre: Short-term mitigations: 1) Ask customer to disable client-side connection reuse (Connection: close) 2) Reduce concurrency and retry with exponential backoff 3) If available, switch to non-streaming endpoint. Also we can try incrementing upstream keepalive pool size for the affected frontdoor but that's infra-invovled.

jade-support: Customer tried Connection: close and saw drop in 504s for a bit but high CPU on upstream model nodes increased.

deploy-bot: [deploy] infra/edge-proxy bump keepalive_pool_size to 512 started at 10:18 UTC (rollout 4/6)

liam-runtime: Rollout looks half-done, but we saw backlog drain on some nodes. Need to confirm if envoy h2-goaway rates drop. Also check for `header_bytes_received` spikes — that long X-Tenant-Meta could be causing buffering to disk in nginx and stalling.

jade-support: Confirming header_bytes spike from customer sessions correlated with 504 peaks.

sam-eng-sre: Action items: - Support to collect full client request + sample trace - Runtime to monitor h2 stream resets and keepalive utilization - Prod infra to finish keepalive bump rollout and watch for regressions. I'll attach a short repro that engineering can run.

sam-eng-sre: repro (short):
```
for i in {1..200}; do 
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer x" -H "X-Tenant-Meta: $(head -c 800 < /dev/urandom | base64)" \
    -d '{"model":"gpt-open-2","input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream &

done; wait
```

nora-product: I'll sync with CS on customer workaround and set expected timeline.

jade-support: TL;DR customer saw 504s due to header-induced buffering + keepalive drain during large concurrent streaming sessions. Waiting on infra roll completion and eng to confirm root cause.

sam-eng-sre: Will follow up with final RCA once keepalive bump completes and we validate h2 metrics. :thumbsup:
